title: Recommendation System Competition Platform
summary: A course competition platform (CS145 RecSys) built on the Sim4Rec simulation framework, where students design and compare recommendation algorithms that maximize revenue over multi-iteration simulated user interactions. The vendored sim4rec modules (generator.py, evaluation.py) use SDV's tabular synthesizers (CopulaGAN, CTGAN, GaussianCopula, TVAE) and its evaluate() function to generate and score synthetic user/item data.
